claims_extracted: Bollinger Band mean reversion entry requires price touching upper/lower band
Stochastic oscillator above 80 (sell) or below 20 (buy) confirms overextension
Bearish/bullish reversal candlestick pattern provides entry timing
Stop loss placed on fractal above/below entry candle
Exit triggered when Stochastic solid line crosses dashed line
Strategy works best in ranging market conditions, not trending
limitations: Source is a free indicator website, not peer-reviewed research
No out-of-sample performance data or statistical significance tests
Strategy may fail in strongly trending markets
No FTMO-specific execution or contract-spec verification
disconfirming_relevance: Ranging-condition dependency means strategy likely fails during trend regimes
No tick-data or spread/slippage modeling included
Fractal-based stop loss may be vulnerable to noise in low timeframes

hypothesis_packets.mechanism: Price touches Bollinger Band extreme (2 std dev) with Stochastic (5,3,3) overbought >80 (sell) or oversold <20 (buy) and a reversal candlestick pattern; entry on pattern completion; stop loss at nearest Williams Fractal; exit when Stochastic %K crosses %D.
hypothesis_packets.falsifiable_prediction: During WFA, the strategy will achieve a positive expectancy in ranging regimes (ADX < 25) but negative expectancy in trending regimes; the false signal rate will increase when ADX > 25.
hypothesis_packets.market_structure_assumption: FTMO/MT5 FX majors exhibit mean-reverting behavior during session overlaps when no dominant trend is present, as measured by ADX below 25.
hypothesis_packets.instrument_scope: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY (FTMO MT5 tradable FX majors)
hypothesis_packets.required_data: OHLC M15 and H1 for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY; Bollinger Bands(20,2); Stochastic(5,3,3); Williams Fractals; ADX(14) for regime filter.
expected_failure_modes: Trend continuation after band touch leads to deep drawdown
Fractal stop too tight in volatile conditions causes premature exit
Band touch without reversal pattern leads to false entry
invalidation_criteria: Mean reversion signal fails when ADX > 25
No statistical edge in out-of-sample period
hypothesis_packets.implementation_shape: Rule-based: compute BB(20,2), Stochastic(5,3,3), Fractals; entry when price closes outside band and Stochastic OB/OS and reversal pattern; SL at nearest fractal; TP when Stochastic crosses; optional ADX trend filter.
hypothesis_packets.execution_sensitivity: Spread sensitivity on lower timeframes; swap costs on overnight holds; session gaps; broker-specific contract specifications.
hypothesis_packets.mt5_ftmo_concerns: MT5 indicator availability for Stochastic and Fractals; tick data for backtesting; FTMO maximum daily loss and profit target constraints; spread widening during news events.
prior_related_lessons: For live tool mode, capture_url_source must include source_id, url, and source_class; the URL must be one returned by search_web in the same run.
record_hypothesis must cite captured source id SRC-LIVE-CANARY-001 and must include source_claims only as Stage-0 source-backed mechanism claims, not MT5 verification or profitability claims.
hypothesis_packets.novelty_reason: Combination of BB touch, Stochastic confirmation, reversal candlestick pattern, and fractal stop is a specific rule set not previously recorded in factory memory; no prior hypothesis packet exists for this exact mechanism.
disconfirming_evidence: Source is a free indicator website with no statistical validation
Strategy performance likely deteriorates in trending markets
Fractal stop may be unreliable on M15
hypothesis_packets.proposed_experiment_shape: WFA on EURUSD M15 from 2020-2025 with walk-forward optimization; test regime filter (ADX threshold) impact; compare with and without Stochastic confirmation.

memory_checked.basis: ResearchBrain required memory, duplicate, and failed-pattern tools were called before accepting a hypothesis.
